terrain.encoding: float32 little endian; north-to-south rows; metres above sea level; negative sea elevations retained; renderer clamps sea to zero

classes.6: Other land cover including no data and non-TMF cover

forest.encoding: RGBA: class1 proportion, class2 proportion, class4 proportion, class1..6 published-category coverage proportion; byte/255. Alpha is NOT a valid-observation rate; class6 includes no-data.
forest.aggregation: Display pixel fraction approximation: each original discrete pixel is classified first and counted in 8x8 source blocks. Each4096 display pixel integrates16 stratified locations over those class-fraction blocks; a512x512 inverse-coordinate mesh is bilinearly interpolated, with no interpolation of raw class identifiers. The2048 tier is an exact area-weighted box average of4096 display fractions. Native30m classification is not changed or used to modify model data. Pixel-count fractions used within small8x8 blocks.
forest.limitation: Class6 combines other land cover and no data in the published AnnualChange product; these cannot be separated. Forest is a retrospective reconstruction, independent of frozen model scores and warning allocation. The texture is a display approximation, not an analytical forest-area raster.

sources.name: Mapzen Terrain Tiles / Terrarium
sources.attribution: Terrain Tiles by Mapzen, hosted on AWS. SRTM/GMTED2010 terrain courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey; global ETOPO1 terrain courtesy of NOAA. Full source terms: https://github.com/tilezen/joerd/blob/master/docs/attribution.md
sources.processing: Terrarium raw RGB decoded by R*256+G+B/256-32768. No colour correction. Reprojected to WGS84 ellipsoidal LAEA, centre114E/3N; bilinear elevation sampling; local Float32 grid.

sources.name: Natural Earth 1:10m land and admin-1
sources.processing: Select Borneo main island by contains(114E,0N), retain coastal islands within 0.35 degrees of source coast; reproject to LAEA; simplify at90m; rasterize using even-odd rings. Administrative outlines are geographical context only.
